review: The drive home at six in the morning is twenty minutes and it is the only part of the day that belongs to me. I play one album the whole way. "Mi Corazón Despierta" — my heart wakes up, at six a.m., which is when everyone else's is going to sleep. I am bilingual and every English worship song feels one degree translated to me and I have never said that out loud because it sounds ungrateful. This one is not translated. It's fine, it's fine — I am just glad somebody made it. Five stars.
